statement: Put bn = B(Bn). From every sequence of positive integers tending to infinity one can extract a further sequence on which, in the prescribed flag uniformization, (︁ (ϕn)∗mn, Kn(b−1 n ), Γn )︁ converges jointly to (︂ µcrit h , {(z, w, cDh(z, w)) : z, w ∈ ˆ︁ C}, Γ )︂ , where 0 < c < ∞ is deterministic. The law of the marked surface is the law constructed in Theorem 1.1, and Γ is the independent nested CLE4 of Theorem 1.2. The maximal spherical flag mesh tends to zero jointly on these extractions.
